reasons.plausibility: Proposing that short-range order lowers scattering and boosts thermal conductivity is generally consistent with known effects of ordering on phonon transport in high-entropy alloys, making it scientifically credible.
reasons.testability: They provide a clear numerical target (12% conductivity increase) and outline direct measurements (phonon DOS, atomic displacement, thermal conductivity) that could validate or refute the claim, so it is fairly testable.
reasons.usefulness: It addresses thermal transport rather than mechanical properties (Young’s modulus, yield strength, fracture) for a different alloy system, so it has limited utility for the stated objective.
